title: Reporting what others say: según and decir que

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know how to report information with *según* from B1 Unit 13. With *según* + the source you say who tells us something, and with *decir que* you report what people said. Historians do this all the time.

items.spanish: Según muchos historiadores, aparecieron nuevas clases sociales.
items.english: According to many historians, new social classes appeared.

items.spanish: Según los historiadores, la clase media pedía más participación política.
items.english: According to historians, the middle class was asking for more political participation.

items.spanish: Muchos obreros decían que necesitaban sindicatos para defender sus salarios.
items.english: Many workers said that they needed unions to defend their wages.

items.spanish: Los patrones decían que los sindicatos eran un peligro para el orden.
items.english: The bosses said that the unions were a danger to order.

sections.content: After *según* there is no *que*: *Según los historiadores, …*. After *decir que* the verb usually moves back in time when you report the past: the workers said "we need unions", so *decían que necesitaban sindicatos*.
